facts.business: Voith Paper Fabrics India Limited is a full-line supplier providing customer-centric solutions for efficient and sustainable papermaking processes, including forming fabrics, press felts, and related services.

segments.name: Paper machine clothing and related products

key_risks: Dependence on related party transactions with Voith Group companies for significant portion of revenue and purchases
Impact of new labour codes leading to exceptional costs (INR 50.97 million in FY2025-26)
Geopolitical uncertainties including wars in Ukraine and Middle East affecting global economies
Raw material price volatility and supply chain disruptions
Competition from domestic and international players in paper machine clothing market
Regulatory changes in environmental norms and labour laws
Foreign exchange fluctuation risks on import of raw materials and export sales
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party transactions with Voith Group companies including Voith Paper Fabrics GmbH & Co. KG (Germany), Voith Paper Technology (China) Co. Ltd., and other Voith entities for purchase of goods, sale of products, royalty payments, and management fees. Total purchases from related parties: INR 684.32 million; Total sales to related parties: INR 412.18 million; Royalty expense: INR 45.67 million; Management fees: INR 28.45 million.
